items.title: Denny Zeitlin interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: really at the hub of all of it I feel is my life with my wife Josephine. We’ve been together for 35 years.

ctx.x: This is the first time for me and I can see what you mean so far.

Yeah it’s been just right, although certainly there is a sacrifice. If you live right in New York where all that foment is and there’s a lot of business opportunities always, networking and stuff, it would have been easier to keep a higher profile going. But I really was more concerned with the overall quality that my life would have and the balance and trying to maintain a balance, and really at the hub of all of it I feel is my life with my wife Josephine. We’ve been together for 35 years. And that seems at the…
